messages:
Alex: Evening handoff — I'm handing off to Maya (primary) and Ron (secondary). Quick summary: 20:08–20:22 UTC we saw a 429/timeout spike originating from the kv-cache tail group in us-west-2. Approx impact: ~3% of requests experienced elevated latency/errors. Two customers (acme-inc, noteapp) reported timeouts. Mitigations were applied, status: monitoring.
incident-bot: Pager #1234 triggered — kv-cache-tail errors > 5% over 5m. Links: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1234
Maya: Taking primary. Current state: rotated traffic off tail hosts tail-12..15 to fallback pool; fallback nodes serving increased load, no full OOM. Autoscale didn't kick due to cooldown window.
Ron: I'm on secondary standby. I'll run a manual eviction pass on the tail group and monitor replication lag.
Jules: I pushed a small routing tweak to prefer prefix-cache where available to reduce tail hot-key pressure. Deployed at 20:14 UTC.
Kiara: Observability update: token latency P95 jumped from ~160ms -> ~420ms at peak. Error rate peaked ~4.1% and is currently ~1.8%. KV tail node CPU spiked on tail-13.
Alex: Runbook pointer: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-tail-ops — we followed steps 1..3: rotate tails, increase eviction window, trigger manual compaction.
Ron: Executing manual eviction now (ops proxy). Command used:
```bash
# run on ops-proxy
./kvctl evict --group tail-usw2 --prefix=hot --batch=5000
```
Ron: Evict completed. Logs show ~412k keys evicted, success on nodes tail-12/tail-13. Some 5xx while eviction was running but decreased after.
incident-bot: Incident #1234 status changed: triggered -> mitigation in progress -> monitoring.
Maya: Customer impact details: acme-inc observed ~45 failed requests during the 14-minute window; Support ticket #7890 opened and CS notified. Noteapp reported a handful of delayed responses but recovered.
Alex: Next steps: monitor key metrics for 60m. If error rate remains >1% for >15m, escalate to infra-owner Sarah. Ron to add a 5% canary routing to warm-pool as a temporary fallback for 24h.
Ron: Added canary rule at 20:36 UTC sending 5% traffic to warm-pool-usw2. Monitoring green so far.
Kiara: Traces collected and linked: https://redwood.internal/traces/1234 — I'll capture representative spans for the postmortem.
Jules: Action item: add autoscale cooldown override for critical cache groups to avoid blocked autoscale during short surges. Filing INFRA-2697.
Alex: Handoff checklist for incoming shift: 1) Maya owns primary for next 8h, Ron is secondary until 04:00 local. 2) Owners on incident ticket: Maya, Ron, Jules. 3) Monitor metrics (errors, p95, kv queue depth) and post updates every 30m or on change.
Maya: Taking it, will update every 30m. :thumbsup:
srebot: Reminder — on-call docs and emergency contacts: /sops/oncall and /sops/infra/escalation. Make sure primary/secondary contact info is reachable.
Alex: Closing note: keep this thread alive with status updates until we return to baseline (<0.5% error rate and p95 <200ms). I'll follow up on postmortem skeleton after metrics settle.
Maya: No questions. Starting active monitoring.
